title: A világosi fegyverletétel és a vértanúk (Defeat at Világos & The Martyrs)
grammar: Political Declarations, Subjunctive Demands & 1848 Narrative Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened at Világos and at Arad in 1849.
I can use fixed phrases such as fejet hajt and emlékére to remember the dead.
I can say why 6 October is a day of mourning in Hungary.
I can use six new words about Világos and the martyrs of Arad.
